title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-a4n2.3: TX queue packets_sent incremented before radio TX succeeds
description:
In commit 1a774fce5, tx_queue_pop() increments queue->stats.packets_sent at tx_queue.c:367 before the actual radio transmission (lichen_lora_l2_tx / lora_send). If the radio TX subsequently fails (e.g., -EBUSY from CCA, -EIO from SPI), packets_sent is permanently inflated — it counts frames that were dequeued but never actually transmitted.

Affected call sites:
- lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lichen_l2.c:1578 (pop before lichen_lora_l2_tx at line 1585)
- lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2.c:1312 (pop before lora_send at line 1358)

Fix options:
(a) Move radio TX before the queue pop (reorder in lichen_l2.c; lora_l2.c would need deeper restructuring),
(b) Only increment packets_sent on successful radio TX return, or
(c) Add a separate 'packets_dequeued' stat so packets_sent accurately reflects over-the-air completions.

This is a diagnostic/monitoring integrity issue — does not affect data correctness, but makes TX failure statistics unreliable.
